ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT l.ARECOD                                      AS location_area,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.LODNUM)                      AS pallets_loads_stored
FROM dbo.invlod i
JOIN dbo.locmst l
  ON l.WH_ID = i.WH_ID
 AND l.STOLOC = i.STOLOC
WHERE i.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.ARECOD
ORDER BY pallets_loads_stored DESC, l.ARECOD;

ask.question: Which parts have no footprint detail?
warnings: Executed but returned 0 rows - check filters / parameter values before trusting it.
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP 200
       d.wh_id,
       d.prt_client_id,
       d.prtnum
FROM dbo.pckwrk_dtl d
WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr h
      WHERE h.wrkref = d.wrkref
        AND h.wh_id = @wh_id
        AND h.ftpcod IS NOT NULL
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(h.ftpcod)) <> N''
  )
GROUP BY
       d.wh_id,
       d.prt_client_id,
       d.prtnum
ORDER BY
       d.prt_client_id,
       d.prtnum;

ask.question: Count open pick work per wave / pick batch
warnings: Executed but returned 0 rows - check filters / parameter values before trusting it.
ask.sql:
SELECT
    b.SCHBAT,
    b.PRICOD,
    b.BATCOD,
    b.BATSTS,
    b.RELDTE,
    b.CMPDTE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.WKONUM) AS open_work_orders,
    COUNT_BIG(*)             AS open_work_lines,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.PCKQTY > 0 THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE CAST(0 AS bigint) END) AS open_lines_with_pick_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.PCKQTY > 0 THEN CAST(w.PCKQTY AS bigint) ELSE CAST(0 AS bigint) END) AS open_pick_qty_units
FROM dbo.pckbat b
JOIN dbo.wkodtl w
  ON w.INSKEY = b.SCHBAT
 AND w.WH_ID  = b.WH_ID
WHERE b.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND w.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND w.LINSTS <> 'C'
GROUP BY
    b.SCHBAT, b.PRICOD, b.BATCOD, b.BATSTS, b.RELDTE, b.CMPDTE
ORDER BY
    b.SCHBAT DESC;

ask.question: List the 20 most recent inventory movements with part, quantity and from / to location
warnings: Empty in every returned row: oprcod, reacod, dtlnum
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP 200
       d.trndte                          AS move_dte,
       d.prtnum,
       p.dsp_prtnum                      AS part_display,
       d.trnqty                          AS qty,
       d.frstol                          AS from_stoloc,
       d.tostol                          AS to_stoloc,
       d.oprcod,
       d.actcod,
       d.reacod,
       d.movref,
       d.lodnum,
       d.subnum,
       d.dtlnum
FROM dbo.dlytrn d
LEFT JOIN dbo.prtmst p
       ON p.prtnum = d.prtnum
      AND p.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
      AND p.wh_id_tmpl = d.wh_id
WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND (d.frstol IS NOT NULL OR d.tostol IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY d.trndte DESC, d.dlytrn_id DESC;

ask.question: How many locations exist per area, and how many of them are empty?
ask.sql:
SELECT m.ARECOD AS arecod,
       COUNT(*) AS location_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.STOLOC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_location_count
FROM dbo.locmst m
LEFT JOIN dbo.invlod i
       ON i.WH_ID = m.WH_ID
      AND i.STOLOC = m.STOLOC
WHERE m.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY m.ARECOD
ORDER BY m.ARECOD;

ask.question: Inventory quantity per part and inventory status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    i.prtnum,
    i.prt_client_id,
    i.invsts,
    SUM(CAST(i.untqty AS bigint)) AS inv_qty_units
FROM dbo.inventory_view i
JOIN dbo.prtmst p
  ON p.prtnum = i.prtnum
 AND p.prt_client_id = i.prt_client_id
 AND p.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
WHERE i.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    i.prtnum,
    i.prt_client_id,
    i.invsts
ORDER BY
    i.prtnum,
    i.prt_client_id,
    i.invsts;

ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       m.ARECOD                                           AS location_area_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.LODNUM)                            AS pallets_stored
FROM dbo.invlod l
JOIN dbo.locmst m
  ON m.STOLOC = l.STOLOC
 AND m.WH_ID  = l.WH_ID
WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY m.ARECOD
ORDER BY pallets_stored DESC, m.ARECOD;

ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    lm.arecod AS location_area,
    COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT il.lodnum) AS pallets_stored
FROM prodwms.invlod AS il
JOIN prodwms.locmst AS lm
    ON lm.wh_id = il.wh_id
   AND lm.stoloc = il.stoloc
WHERE il.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    lm.arecod

ask.question: Top 20 parts by number of pallets in stock
ask.sql:
WITH pallets_by_part AS (
    SELECT
        id.prtnum,
        id.prt_client_id,
        pallet_cnt = COUNT(DISTINCT isb.lodnum)
    FROM prodwms.invdtl id
    JOIN prodwms.invsub isb
        ON isb.subnum = id.subnum
    JOIN prodwms.invlod il
        ON il.lodnum = isb.lodnum
       AND il.wh_id = @wh_id
    WHERE id.untqty <> 0
    GROUP BY
        id.prtnum,
        id.prt_client_id
)
SELECT TOP 200
    p.prtnum,
    p.prt_client_id,
    p.dsp_prtnum,
    x.pallet_cnt
FROM pallets_by_part x
JOIN prodwms.prtmst p
    ON p.prtnum = x.prtnum
   AND p.prt_client_id = x.prt_client_id
   AND p.wh_id_tmpl IN (@wh_id, '----')
ORDER BY
    x.pallet_cnt DESC,
    p.prtnum,
    p.prt_client_id;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod,
    COUNT(*) AS unit_load_count
FROM [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.unitld u
JOIN [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.locatn l
    ON l.subsit = u.subsit
   AND l.locatn = u.locatn
GROUP BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod
ORDER BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod;

ask.question: Top 20 items by number of unit loads in stock
ask.sql:
WITH ul_by_item AS (
    SELECT
        ud.itmcls,
        ud.itmcod,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ud.ulid) AS unit_loads_in_stock
    FROM [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.UNTDTL ud
    JOIN [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.UNITLD ul
        ON ul.ulid = ud.ulid
    WHERE ul.subsit IN ('0','1')
      AND ul.locatn IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        ud.itmcls,
        ud.itmcod
)
SELECT TOP (20)
    u.itmcls,
    u.itmcod,
    im.itmdsc,
    u.unit_loads_in_stock
FROM ul_by_item u
LEFT JOIN [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.ITMMST im
    ON im.itmcls = u.itmcls
   AND im.itmcod = u.itmcod
ORDER BY
    u.unit_loads_in_stock DESC,
    u.itmcls,
    u.itmcod;

convert.title: CBO_P_CLASS_INVENTORY_DE07_VIEW
convert.sql:
WITH s1 AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        lm.stoloc                  AS LOCATN,
        id.prtnum                  AS ITMCOD,
        pm.prtfam                  AS ITMGRP,
        il.lodnum                  AS ULID20,
        CONVERT(int, ISNULL(id.untqty, 0)) AS CASQTY,
        id.invsts                  AS QASTAT,
        id.fifdte                  AS FIFODT,
        id.lotnum                  AS CTLGRP,
        id.ftpcod                  AS ULPALL,
        lm.arecod                  AS ZONCOD,
        CASE
            WHEN lm.arecod = 'X1' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 1')
            WHEN lm.arecod = 'X2' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 2')
            WHEN lm.arecod = 'X3' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 3')
            WHEN lm.arecod = 'X4' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 4')
            WHEN lm.arecod = 'X5' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 5')
            WHEN lm.arecod = 'XC' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Modul')
            ELSE CONVERT(varchar(10), 'not defined')
        END                        AS BLDING,
        CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING(pm.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'W' OR pm.prtfam = 'PAPPWP' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Wipes')
            WHEN SUBSTRING(pm.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'R' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Rawmaterial')
            WHEN SUBSTRING(pm.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'P' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Packmaterial')
            ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
        END                        AS MATTYP,
        id.prt_client_id
    FROM dbo.invlod AS il
    INNER JOIN dbo.invsub AS isb
        ON isb.lodnum = il.lodnum
    INNER JOIN dbo.invdtl AS id
        ON id.subnum = isb.subnum
    INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS lm
        ON lm.wh_id = il.wh_id
       AND lm.stoloc = il.stoloc
    INNER JOIN dbo.prtmst AS pm
        ON pm.prtnum = id.prtnum
       AND pm.prt_client_id = id.prt_client_id
       AND pm.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    WHERE il.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND pm.prdflg = 1
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    s1.LOCATN,
    s1.ITMCOD,
    s1.ITMGRP,
    s1.ULID20,
    s1.CASQTY,
    s1.QASTAT,
    s1.FIFODT,
    s1.CTLGRP,
    s1.ULPALL,
    s1.ZONCOD,
    (GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time') AS last_update,
    s1.BLDING,
    s1.MATTYP,
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(pu.pal_flg, 0) = 1 THEN CONVERT(int, ISNULL(pu.hgt, 0) + 15)
        ELSE CONVERT(int, ISNULL(pu.hgt, 0))
    END AS calculated_pal_height,
    pu.uomcod AS UOM,
    s1.CTLGRP AS VNDCOD,
    s1.CTLGRP AS VNDLOT,
    CONCAT(s1.ULPALL, s1.ITMCOD) AS ULPAL_ITEM
FROM s1
OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT TOP (1)
        pfd.uomcod,
        pfd.hgt,
        pfd.pal_flg
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS pfd
    WHERE pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND pfd.prtnum = s1.ITMCOD
      AND pfd.prt_client_id = s1.prt_client_id
) AS pu;

convert.title: Direct_LINE_BEVO_PRIORITIES
convert.sql:
WITH rl AS (
    SELECT
        il.stoloc,
        id.prtnum,
        id.lotnum,
        id.sup_lotnum
    FROM dbo.invdtl id
    JOIN dbo.invsub isb
        ON id.subnum = isb.subnum
    JOIN dbo.invlod il
        ON isb.lodnum = il.lodnum
    JOIN dbo.locmst lm
        ON il.stoloc = lm.stoloc
       AND il.wh_id  = lm.wh_id
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
        ON pm.prtnum = id.prtnum
       AND pm.prt_client_id = id.prt_client_id
       AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    WHERE il.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND id.phdflg = 0
      AND il.stoloc NOT LIKE '%RWZ%'
      AND id.invsts = 'RL'
),
B AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS ULIDs,
        stoloc,
        prtnum,
        sup_lotnum
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY stoloc, prtnum, sup_lotnum
),
D AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS ULIDs,
        sup_lotnum
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY sup_lotnum
),
E AS (
    SELECT
        h.wkonum AS PRDORD,
        h.sch_begdte AS ACTDAT,
        h.sch_enddte AS ENDDAT,
        h.prtnum AS SPCCD1,
        SUM(ISNULL(d.linqty,0) - ISNULL(d.tot_dlvqty,0)) AS Offener_Bedarf_IN_WM_Unit,
        h.prdlin AS LINIE,
        h.prtnum AS ITMCOD
    FROM dbo.wkohdr h
    JOIN dbo.wkodtl d
        ON d.wkonum = h.wkonum
       AND d.client_id = h.client_id
       AND d.wkorev = h.wkorev
       AND d.wh_id = h.wh_id
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
        ON pm.prtnum = h.prtnum
       AND pm.prt_client_id = h.prt_client_id
       AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.prdlin_mst l
        ON l.prdlin = h.prdlin
       AND l.wh_id = h.wh_id
    WHERE h.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND h.wkosts = 'A'
      AND (ISNULL(d.linqty,0) - ISNULL(d.tot_dlvqty,0)) > 0
    GROUP BY
        h.wkonum, h.sch_begdte, h.sch_enddte, h.prdlin, h.prtnum
),
A AS (
    SELECT TOP (200)
        l.prdlin AS PLNUMB,
        h.wkonum AS PRDORD,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        h.prtnum AS SPCCOD,
        d.seqnum AS LINSEQ,
        d.prcloc AS LOCATN,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        d.sup_lotnum AS VNDCOD,
        d.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT
    FROM dbo.wkohdr h
    JOIN dbo.wkodtl d
        ON d.wkonum = h.wkonum
       AND d.client_id = h.client_id
       AND d.wkorev = h.wkorev
       AND d.wh_id = h.wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.prdlin_mst l
        ON l.prdlin = h.prdlin
       AND l.wh_id = h.wh_id
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
        ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
       AND pm.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
       AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    WHERE h.wh_id = @wh_id
)
SELECT
    A.PLNUMB,
    A.PRDORD,
    E.ACTDAT,
    E.ENDDAT,
    A.ITMCOD,
    A.SPCCOD,
    A.LINSEQ,
    A.LOCATN,
    A.CTLGRP,
    A.VNDCOD,
    A.VNDLOT,
    B.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
    D.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
    FORMAT(CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS datetime), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS Last_Update
FROM A
LEFT JOIN B
    ON A.SPCCOD = B.prtnum
   AND A.LOCATN = B.stoloc
   AND A.VNDLOT = B.sup_lotnum
   AND A.VNDCOD = B.sup_lotnum
LEFT JOIN D
    ON A.VNDCOD = D.sup_lotnum
LEFT JOIN E
    ON A.ITMCOD = E.ITMCOD
   AND A.SPCCOD = E.SPCCD1
   AND A.PRDORD = E.PRDORD

UNION

SELECT
    NULL AS PLNUMB,
    NULL AS PRDORD,
    NULL AS ACTDAT,
    NULL AS ENDDAT,
    NULL AS ITMCOD,
    NULL AS SPCCOD,
    NULL AS LINSEQ,
    NULL AS LOCATN,
    NULL AS CTLGRP,
    NULL AS VNDCOD,
    NULL AS VNDLOT,
    NULL AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
    NULL AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
    FORMAT(MAX(t.trndte), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS Last_Update
FROM dbo.dlytrn t
JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
    ON pm.prtnum = t.prtnum
   AND pm.prt_client_id = t.prt_client_id
   AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
WHERE t.wh_id = @wh_id;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH p1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE dt.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE dt.tostol END AS LINE,
        CONVERT(varchar(19), dt.trndte, 120) AS DELIVERY_DATE,
        dt.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.lngdsc, 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
        dt.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(dt.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
        dt.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
        dt.trnqty AS QTY,
        uom.UOM AS WM_UNIT,
        dt.orgcod AS PROCESS_ORDER,
        LEFT(dt.lodnum, 20) AS ULID,
        CONCAT(LEFT(dt.lodnum, 20), FORMAT(dt.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
    FROM dbo.dlytrn dt
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
      ON pm.prtnum = dt.prtnum
     AND pm.prt_client_id = dt.prt_client_id
     AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pdd.lngdsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc pdd
        WHERE pdd.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND pdd.colval = dt.prtnum
          AND pdd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pdd.locale_id
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pfd.uomcod AS UOM
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = dt.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = dt.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
    ) uom
    WHERE dt.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND dt.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND dt.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')
      AND dt.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
),
sq1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE dt.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE dt.tostol END AS LINE,
        dt.dlytrn_id
    FROM dbo.dlytrn dt
    WHERE dt.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND dt.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND dt.oprcod = 'T'
      AND dt.orgcod IS NOT NULL
      AND dt.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
),
p2 AS (
    SELECT
        sq1.LINE AS LINE,
        CONVERT(varchar(19), dt.trndte, 120) AS DELIVERY_DATE,
        dt.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.lngdsc, 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
        dt.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(dt.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
        dt.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
        dt.trnqty AS QTY,
        uom.UOM AS WM_UNIT,
        dt.orgcod AS PROCESS_ORDER,
        LEFT(dt.lodnum, 20) AS ULID,
        CONCAT(LEFT(dt.lodnum, 20), FORMAT(dt.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
    FROM dbo.dlytrn dt
    JOIN sq1
      ON sq1.dlytrn_id = dt.dlytrn_id
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
      ON pm.prtnum = dt.prtnum
     AND pm.prt_client_id = dt.prt_client_id
     AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pdd.lngdsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc pdd
        WHERE pdd.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND pdd.colval = dt.prtnum
          AND pdd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pdd.locale_id
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pfd.uomcod AS UOM
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = dt.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = dt.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
    ) uom
    WHERE dt.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND dt.oprcod = 'F'
      AND dt.actcod = 'CASXFR'
      AND dt.orgcod IS NOT NULL
      AND dt.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
)
SELECT TOP 200
    LINE,
    DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VENDOR,
    VENDOR_LOT,
    QTY,
    WM_UNIT,
    PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    ID_NR
FROM (
    SELECT LINE, DELIVERY_DATE, ITMCOD, DESCRIPTION, CTLGRP, VENDOR, VENDOR_LOT, QTY, WM_UNIT, PROCESS_ORDER, ULID, ID_NR FROM p1
    UNION
    SELECT LINE, DELIVERY_DATE, ITMCOD, DESCRIPTION, CTLGRP, VENDOR, VENDOR_LOT, QTY, WM_UNIT, PROCESS_ORDER, ULID, ID_NR FROM p2
) u;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
WITH p1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE d.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.tostol END AS LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.short_dsc, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(d.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        d.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        uom1.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
      ON pm.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
     AND pm.prtnum        = d.prtnum
     AND pm.wh_id_tmpl    = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) p.short_dsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc p
        WHERE p.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND p.colval = d.prtnum
        ORDER BY p.locale_id
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pfd.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum        = d.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id         = @wh_id
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
    ) uom1
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')
      AND d.trndte >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.trndte <= GETDATE()
),
sq1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE d.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.tostol END AS LOCATN,
        d.dlytrn_id AS TRNSEQ
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.oprcod = 'T'
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL
      AND d.trndte >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.trndte <= GETDATE()
),
p2 AS (
    SELECT
        sq1.LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(pd.short_dsc, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(d.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        d.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        uom1.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN sq1
      ON sq1.TRNSEQ = d.dlytrn_id
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
      ON pm.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
     AND pm.prtnum        = d.prtnum
     AND pm.wh_id_tmpl    = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) p.short_dsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc p
        WHERE p.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND p.colval = d.prtnum
        ORDER BY p.locale_id
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pfd.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum        = d.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id         = @wh_id
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
    ) uom1
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.oprcod = 'F'
      AND d.actcod = 'CASXFR'
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL
      AND d.trndte >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.trndte <= GETDATE()
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM p1
UNION
SELECT TOP (200)
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM p2;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
SELECT TOP 200
       CASE dt.frstol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE dt.frstol END AS LINE,
       CONVERT(varchar(19), dt.trndte, 120) AS RETURN_DATE,
       dt.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
       LEFT(COALESCE(pds.lngdsc, pds.short_dsc), 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
       dt.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
       LEFT(dtl.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
       dtl.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
       dt.trnqty AS QTY,
       uom.uomcod AS WM_UNIT,
       SUBSTRING(dt.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       dt.lodnum AS ULID,
       CONCAT(dt.lodnum, FORMAT(dt.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM dbo.dlytrn dt
JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
  ON pm.prtnum = dt.prtnum
 AND pm.prt_client_id = dt.prt_client_id
 AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 i.prtnum, i.prt_client_id, i.supnum, i.sup_lotnum
    FROM dbo.invdtl i
    WHERE i.prtnum = dt.prtnum
      AND i.prt_client_id = dt.prt_client_id
      AND i.lotnum = dt.lotnum
) dtl
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 pd.lngdsc, pd.short_dsc
    FROM dbo.prtdsc pd
    WHERE pd.colnam = 'prtnum'
      AND pd.colval = dt.prtnum
) pds
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 pfd.uomcod
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
    WHERE pfd.prtnum = dt.prtnum
      AND pfd.prt_client_id = dt.prt_client_id
      AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
) uom
WHERE dt.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND pm.typcod = 'P'
  AND dt.frstol LIKE 'ULIN%'
  AND dt.actcod = 'MANLID'
  AND dt.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE());

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
WITH uom_pick AS (
    SELECT
        pfd.prtnum,
        pfd.prt_client_id,
        pfd.wh_id,
        pfd.uomcod,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pfd.prtnum, pfd.prt_client_id, pfd.wh_id
            ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl ASC, pfd.uomcod
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
    WHERE pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND pfd.stk_flg = 1
)
SELECT TOP (200)
       CASE d.frstol
            WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4'
            WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3'
            ELSE d.frstol
       END AS LINE,
       FORMAT(d.trndte, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
       LEFT(COALESCE(pdesc.short_dsc, pdesc.lngdsc), 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
       d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
       LEFT(d.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
       d.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
       d.trnqty AS QTY,
       up.uomcod AS WM_UNIT,
       SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       d.lodnum AS ULID,
       CONCAT(d.lodnum, FORMAT(d.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM dbo.dlytrn d
JOIN dbo.prtmst p
  ON p.prtnum = d.prtnum
 AND p.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
 AND p.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           pd.short_dsc,
           pd.lngdsc
    FROM dbo.prtdsc pd
    WHERE pd.colnam = 'prtnum'
      AND pd.colval = d.prtnum
      AND pd.is_purged = 0
    ORDER BY pd.locale_id
) pdesc
LEFT JOIN uom_pick up
  ON up.prtnum = d.prtnum
 AND up.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
 AND up.wh_id = d.wh_id
 AND up.rn = 1
WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND d.frstol LIKE 'ULIN%'
  AND d.actcod = 'MANLID'
  AND d.trndte > DATEADD(DAY, -33, GETDATE())
  AND d.trndte <= GETDATE();

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURNS_90days_wholeQtyBack
convert.sql:
WITH deliv AS (
    SELECT
        st.trndte AS DELIVERY_DATE,
        CASE
            WHEN sd.tostol = 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4'
            WHEN sd.tostol = 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3'
            ELSE sd.tostol
        END AS LINE,
        sd.orgcod AS PROCESS_ORDER,
        sd.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        sd.trnqty AS QTY,
        uom.WHSE_UNIT AS WHSE_UNIT,
        LEFT(sd.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn sd
    JOIN dbo.dlytrn st
      ON st.dlytrn_id = sd.dlytrn_id
     AND st.wh_id = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pfd.uomcod AS WHSE_UNIT
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = sd.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = sd.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd.rcv_flg = 1
          AND pfd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl ASC, pfd.uomcod ASC
    ) uom
    WHERE sd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND sd.actcod IN (N'DEPSUL', N'LINUSE')
      AND sd.tostol LIKE N'ULIN%'
), ret AS (
    SELECT
        sd.lodnum AS ULID,
        st.trndte AS RETURN_DATE,
        sd.trnqty AS QTY
    FROM dbo.dlytrn sd
    JOIN dbo.dlytrn st
      ON st.dlytrn_id = sd.dlytrn_id
     AND st.wh_id = @wh_id
    WHERE sd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND sd.actcod = N'MANLID'
      AND sd.tostol LIKE N'ULIN%'
), RankedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        a.DELIVERY_DATE,
        a.LINE,
        a.PROCESS_ORDER,
        a.ITMCOD,
        p.prtfam AS ITMGRP,
        famdsc.lngdsc AS grpdsc,
        a.QTY,
        a.WHSE_UNIT,
        a.ULID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ULID ORDER BY a.DELIVERY_DATE ASC) AS DeliveryRank
    FROM deliv a
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.prtnum = a.ITMCOD
     AND p.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d.lngdsc
        FROM dbo.dscmst d
        WHERE d.colval = p.prtfam
          AND d.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY d.locale_id ASC
    ) famdsc
    WHERE a.DELIVERY_DATE > CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -90, GETDATE()) AS date)
      AND a.DELIVERY_DATE < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      AND a.LINE NOT LIKE N'ULINA%'
      AND a.LINE NOT LIKE N'ULINC%'
), RankedReturns AS (
    SELECT
        b.ULID,
        b.RETURN_DATE,
        b.QTY,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.ULID ORDER BY b.RETURN_DATE ASC) AS ReturnRank
    FROM ret b
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    d.DELIVERY_DATE,
    d.LINE,
    d.PROCESS_ORDER,
    d.ITMCOD,
    d.ITMGRP,
    d.grpdsc,
    d.QTY,
    d.WHSE_UNIT,
    d.ULID,
    r.RETURN_DATE,
    r.QTY AS RETURN_QTY,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) AS DATE_DIFF
FROM RankedDeliveries d
JOIN RankedReturns r
  ON r.ULID = d.ULID
 AND r.ReturnRank = d.DeliveryRank
WHERE d.DELIVERY_DATE < r.RETURN_DATE
  AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) < 960
  AND d.QTY = r.QTY
ORDER BY d.ULID, d.DELIVERY_DATE ASC;
